answer: Sybil resistance via tokenized identity mandates a unique capital stake for each AI agent. An attacker confronts an economic knoll, where each fake identity requires its own substantial token lock-up. The cumulative cost is a raven, relentlessly devouring capital. This makes establishing myriad identities as difficult as cultivating a lotus in barren soil, ensuring only genuinely committed agents can participate and preventing widespread fake-identity proliferation.
